notes: וְנִסְלַח לוֹ is read by rule 40: the preposition goes unrepresented and its suffix takes the subject pronoun of the English passive.
עַל אַחַת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר is collapsed by the ASV into concerning whatsoever, so אַחַת and the partitive מִן have nothing to take.
The head of לְ → so as to falls on a function word either way; the unit's note names heading on as as the competing reading, which satisfies rule 8.
